_about: AnimeForge model registry. One entry per model or tool the platform may use. `status` decides whether the pipeline may load it for monetized output: cleared = yes; conditional = yes, if every item in `conditions` is met; unverified = licence not fully read yet, so no; blocked = licence forbids commercial use, so no. Nothing here has been benchmarked: `benchmark` stays null until a real run on the target GPU is recorded. Licences were read on `verified_on` from the URLs in `sources`; re-check before relying on them.

models.name: ComfyUI
models.commercial: Output images are not covered by the GPL. The GPL applies to distributing ComfyUI or code linked with it.
conditions: Run ComfyUI as a separate process and talk to it over its HTTP API; do not import its code into AnimeForge.
models.install: git clone, pip install -r requirements.txt, torch with CUDA.

models.name: ComfyUI IPAdapter Plus + IP-Adapter weights
models.commercial: The standard IP-Adapter weights are Apache-2.0.
conditions: Use only the non-FaceID weights. The FaceID variants need InsightFace models, which are non-commercial (see ipadapter-faceid).
Node is GPL-3.0: use it inside ComfyUI only.
models.hardware: Adds roughly 1-2 GB VRAM on SDXL (not measured here).
models.install: ComfyUI custom node + weights in models/ipadapter and a CLIP vision encoder.

models.name: IP-Adapter FaceID
models.weight_license: none stated on the model card
models.commercial: Requires InsightFace face models, which InsightFace licenses for non-commercial research only.

models.name: InsightFace pretrained models (buffalo_l, antelopev2)
models.commercial: README: models trained on their data "are available for non-commercial research purposes only", including auto-downloaded ones. A commercial licence must be obtained from InsightFace.

models.name: PuLID
models.commercial: Code and weights are Apache-2.0, but PuLID is an identity method for real human faces and is commonly run with InsightFace antelopev2 (non-commercial). That dependency was not confirmed from the PuLID repo itself.
conditions: Confirm which face models the chosen PuLID workflow loads. If it needs InsightFace models, treat as blocked.
Check it helps on anime faces at all before spending time on it.

models.name: ControlNet (SDXL union)
models.commercial: No restriction beyond Apache-2.0.
models.hardware: Adds roughly 2-3 GB VRAM on SDXL (not measured here).

models.name: Kohya sd-scripts (LoRA training)
models.commercial: The tool is Apache-2.0. A trained LoRA inherits the base checkpoint's licence and the rights in the training images.
conditions: Train only on images we own or generated ourselves from cleared models; record them in the asset rights registry.
models.hardware: SDXL LoRA training fits in 24 GB (not measured here).

models.name: Stable Diffusion XL base 1.0
models.commercial: Commercial use allowed; the licence's use restrictions apply.
models.hardware: About 8-12 GB VRAM at 1024px (not measured here).

models.name: Animagine XL 4.0 (anime SDXL)
models.commercial: Licence allows commercial use.
conditions: Anime checkpoints learn from existing anime art and can reproduce known characters by name. Prompt only our own original characters; never name an existing franchise character or artist.
models.hardware: About 8-12 GB VRAM at 1024px (not measured here).

models.name: Illustrious XL / NoobAI XL
models.commercial: Custom licence (https://freedevproject.org/faipl-1.0-sd/). Its terms for commercial output and for derivatives were not read in full.
conditions: Read the full licence before use.

models.name: Wan2.1
models.commercial: README: models are Apache-2.0 and the authors claim no rights over generated content. Content restrictions in the licence apply.
models.hardware: README: T2V-1.3B needs 8.19 GB VRAM, about 4 minutes for 5 s of 480p on an RTX 4090. The 14B image-to-video model's fit in 24 GB was not verified.

models.name: Wan 2.2 Animate
models.commercial: Code and weights are Apache-2.0.
conditions: It animates a character image from a driving video of a person. Use only reference video we filmed ourselves or hold a licence for; the performer must have agreed to this use.

The official commands are documented for a GPU with at least 80 GB VRAM. Running on 24 GB needs a quantized or offloaded variant, which is a different checkpoint: register and licence-check that exact file before using it.
models.hardware: README: official inference commands need 80 GB VRAM. Fit on 24 GB is not verified.
models.install: Wan2.2 repository or ComfyUI nodes; preprocessing models for pose and face are extra downloads whose licences must be checked.

models.name: Wan 2.2 Fun Control
models.commercial: Code and weights are Apache-2.0.
conditions: Control inputs (pose, depth, edges) come from a reference video: use only video we own or licensed.
The 5B variant is the realistic starting point for 24 GB; the A14B variant's fit is not verified.

models.name: LTX-Video
models.checkpoint: Lightricks/LTX-Video (0.9.6+ under LTXV Open Weights License 0.X)
models.weight_license: LTXV Open Weights License 0.X (custom), older versions have their own licence files
models.commercial: Custom weight licence dated 2025-04-15. Its commercial-use terms were not read in full.
conditions: Read LTX-Video-Open-Weights-License-0.X.txt in full, including any revenue limit, before use.

models.name: AnimateDiff
models.commercial: No restriction beyond Apache-2.0. SD1.5-era; the base checkpoint used with it carries its own licence.
models.hardware: About 8-12 GB VRAM for 16 frames at 512px (not measured here).

models.name: Blender
models.commercial: Renders made with Blender are the user's own.
conditions: Call Blender as an external program; do not link its code.
models.install: Not installed on the development machine.

models.name: AI4Bharat Indic Parler-TTS
models.commercial: Tagged Apache-2.0, but the model is gated and its card (which carries the access terms) returned HTTP 401 without a login.
conditions: Log in to Hugging Face, read and accept the access terms, then record them here.
Voices are made from text descriptions, so no reference recording of a real person is needed: the best fit for original character voices.

models.name: AI4Bharat IndicF5
models.commercial: Weights tagged MIT but gated (card returned HTTP 401). The GitHub repository has no licence file.
conditions: Read and accept the access terms on Hugging Face and record them here.

It clones the voice in a reference clip. Use only reference audio we recorded ourselves or hold a licence for; never a real actor's or a private person's voice, and not the sample prompts shipped with the repo unless their terms allow it.

models.name: Resemble AI Chatterbox Multilingual
models.commercial: MIT. Hindi is a listed language. Every generated file carries an inaudible PerTh watermark.
conditions: Voice cloning needs a reference clip: use only audio we recorded or licensed.
The README says the repository stays public as an archive with no support or updates.

models.name: Indic-Speak
models.commercial: Licence is tagged only as "other" and the card is gated. Built on Llama 3.2, which has its own community licence.
conditions: Read the model's licence and the Llama 3.2 licence before use.

models.name: Kokoro-82M (already used by the existing pipeline)
models.checkpoint: hexgrad/Kokoro-82M, voices hm_omega, hm_psi, hf_alpha, hf_beta
models.weight_license: Apache-2.0 (as stated in this repo's requirements.txt; not re-verified today)
models.commercial: No restriction beyond Apache-2.0.

benchmark.note: about 40 s to synthesize a 48 s Hindi episode (services/tts), 2026-11-11

models.name: LatentSync
models.commercial: Code Apache-2.0, weights OpenRAIL++. Which face detector its preprocessing loads was not checked; if it is an InsightFace model, that part is non-commercial.
conditions: Check the face-detection dependency.
It was built for real faces; the README's anime demo clips come from another project. Test on our anime characters before adopting.
models.hardware: README: 8 GB VRAM for inference with 1.5, 18 GB with 1.6.

models.name: MuseTalk
models.commercial: README: code MIT with no limit on commercial use; trained models "available for any purpose, even commercially".
conditions: README: other models it uses (whisper, ft-mse-vae, dwpose, S3FD and others) must comply with their own licences: check each before use.
Its test data is non-commercial: do not ship it.
Built for real faces: test on our anime characters before adopting.

models.name: Wav2Lip
models.commercial: README: results are for research, academic and personal use only; "any form of commercial use is strictly prohibited".

models.name: RIFE frame interpolation
models.commercial: Code is MIT; the licence of the released weights was not checked.
conditions: Check the weight licence.

models.name: Remotion (already used by the existing pipeline)
models.commercial: Free, including commercial use, for individuals and for-profit organisations of up to 3 employees; larger companies need a company licence.
conditions: Stay within the free-licence eligibility, or buy a company licence.
models.hardware: CPU render; about 7 frames per second at 720x1280 on the development machine.

models.name: FFmpeg
models.code_license: LGPL/GPL depending on the build (the installed gyan.dev full build is GPL)
models.commercial: Using it as an external program to encode our own video is fine.
conditions: Call it as a separate program; do not redistribute it with the platform without meeting its licence.
